evaluation_boundary: Separate evaluation agent on shared host, not external certification. Programmatic checks and static review only; root UI/release reviewer records browser and hosted-source qualification separately.

protected_case_preparation.status: Prepared before relevant candidate source; later-exposed cases become regressions.

checks.name: Direct model/manual use
checks.demonstrated: Project creation, prompt construction, customer-supplied response import and project roundtrip covered programmatically.
checks.not_demonstrated: Complete nontechnical browser mission and actual customer AI-chat interaction pending.

checks.name: Multi-model orchestration
checks.demonstrated: Independent rival contributions preserve separate identities and costs even when local capability names collide; finite planning chooses the lower-cost route without overwriting either contribution. Four provider wire adapters are contract-tested.
checks.not_demonstrated: Authenticated frontier alternatives, rival quality comparison and complete cost comparison have not been executed.

checks.name: Transformational discovery
checks.demonstrated: Custom opportunity outside demo menu can be imported and investigated through a supplied finite capability graph; unsupported evidence remains UNKNOWN.
checks.not_demonstrated: Generation of open-world consequential opportunity and empirical superiority to strongest complete alternative.

checks.name: Adversarial verification
checks.demonstrated: Independent arithmetic cases reject planted addition-for-multiplication error and cost checker exposes incorrect claimed total. Receipt substitution/forgery rejected.
checks.not_demonstrated: General natural-language truth detection or scientific validity.

checks.name: Invent the Economy
checks.demonstrated: Declared participant outside options, exact complete resource-cost arithmetic, funding assumption and competent conventional cost comparison independently checked.
checks.not_demonstrated: Real consent, funding, demand, equilibrium, global optimum or autonomous new market invention.

checks.name: Construction
checks.demonstrated: Bounded arithmetic instruments execute; five preprepared affine-conversion cases match independent direct algebra, while a planted offset error fails all five. Extrapolation receives an explicit out-of-range flag.
checks.not_demonstrated: Arbitrary generated code sandbox or physical production; arbitrary generated code is unsupported.

checks.name: Inheritance
checks.demonstrated: In-session artifact-bound verification is required for verified retention. Fresh supplied successor cases match equal-content ordinary reconstruction.
checks.not_demonstrated: Recursive enabling advantage or discovery-procedure improvement; ordinary control ties.

checks.name: Cost and permissions
checks.demonstrated: Zero operation budget, cancelled workflow, missing credentials, remote permission, atomic reserve, failure cost retention, source query provenance and hostile ZIPs checked with fixtures.
checks.not_demonstrated: Provider-enforced hard billing cap or real billed cancellation. Guard is local process-session estimate.

checks.name: Customer delivery
checks.demonstrated: Project export/import API works; archive boundary tests pass.
checks.not_demonstrated: Extracted actual package browser session, macOS and Windows native/browser testing pending.

checks.name: Official release
checks.demonstrated: Verifier accepts externally pinned archive digest/source revision, rejects tampering and separates manifest assertion from actual source-byte comparison.
checks.not_demonstrated: Published release, downloaded exact-source run, storefront checkout/delivery and authenticated model tests.

release_recommendation: Do not equate these bounded engineering checks with completion of the full commercial mandate. Official sale requires its remaining product and delivery qualification.

provider_developer_suite_rerun_by_review.note: Later provider-owner suite reports23; root integrated qualification records final counts.

costs.note: Included assistant and host resources are not evidence of zero total economic cost.

supplemental_parallel_review.scope: Independent static inspection plus expanded programmatic malformed-import regression; no real vendor calls
supplemental_parallel_review.outcome: Project ownership race and optional-array malformed import defects repaired
supplemental_parallel_review.dom_and_browser_tests: Recorded separately by their executing owners
